retrieval_text:
INCIDENT TYPE:
SESSION HIJACKING

DESCRIPTION:
Session hijacking occurs when attackers steal or manipulate session identifiers to impersonate legitimate users.

THREAT FRAMEWORK:
- MITRE ATT&CK | T1539 | Steal Web Session Cookie

INDICATORS:
- Unexpected session reuse
- Multiple locations using same session
- Unauthorized account actions

DETECTION RULES:
- Session anomalies
- Cookie theft indicators

AFFECTED ASSETS:
- Web applications
- User accounts
title: SESSION HIJACKING
